sql: SELECT json_agg(u ORDER BY u.timestamp) FROM (SELECT c.remote_jid, m.timestamp, m.from_me, m.status, m.message_id, m.metadata->>'source' AS src, left(m.content, 50) AS txt FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE c.contact_phone LIKE '%11959168845%' AND m.timestamp BETWEEN '2026-10-22T11:00:00Z' AND '2026-10-22T16:00:00Z') u
